'''[[IG-100 MagnaGuard]]''' was published in [[Virtual Block 7]]. Its release-sheet and master-list versions are shown below.

== Release-sheet version ==
[[File:VL-history-1273-6-front-original.png|180px|Release-sheet version front face]]

{{anchor|original-front-text}}
Shockstaff deploys and fires for free on this droid. While on Blockade Flagship or Coruscant (or with Cyborg Commander), this droid is Heroic and power +2. Your characters here are immune to Ambush, Clash Of Sabers, and attrition &lt; 4.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Players Committee virtual-card sheet], PDF page 2. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Name change ==
The [[Players Committee]] announced the persona-name change on 29 January 2013, effective immediately; existing slips remained tournament-valid.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], Players Committee, 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>
